firstParagraphs: **Demo Primary School** Ministry of Education, Trinidad & Tobago 5th September 2026 Dear Parents/Guardians, **Re: Upcoming School Sports Day** This letter serves to inform you of our annual school Sports Day, a day for fun, friendly competition, and community spirit. We are pleased to announce that Sports Day will be held on **Friday, 25th September 2026**. We encourage all parents and guardians to attend to support the children. A more detailed schedule of events will be sent out closer to the date. Should you require any further information, please do not hesitate to contact the school office. Yours sincerely, _______________________________ A. Alexander Principal Demo Primary School
